complete_examples.text: The compatibility between two sub-models is maintained by the equilibrium mechanism of the fasteners’ interaction forces.

The two sub-models are coupled by the interaction forces, simultaneously, random track irregularity excitation is considered in the vehicle-rail sub-model and the infinite elements are adopted to simulate the boundary condition of the soil.
